note: The reference implementations and SDKs ride these exact bytes. The Internet-Draft is published through the IETF Independent Submission stream and is not carried in this repository; MANIFEST.sha256 covers the in-repo artifacts (the CDDL wire authority, the machine-readable registries, and the full conformance corpus). Run scripts/verify_pins.py to recompute every pinned hash and compare; any drift exits non-zero. All pinned files are stored LF (.gitattributes eol=lf) so the hashes are platform-independent.
